metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel scheduled analytics rules for power-platform-admin.
metadata.author: power-platform-security-baseline

metadata.description: Name of the Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace.

properties.displayName: Power Platform - DLP policy created, updated or removed by non-approved admin
properties.description:
Detects Power Platform Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy creation, modification or deletion performed by an account outside the approved Power Platform administrator list.
Closes a gap in the out-of-the-box rule 'Power Platform - DLP policy updated or removed', which ignores CreateDlpPolicy, suppresses edits within 10 minutes of creation, and does not enforce an approved administrator allow-list.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0263, ISM-0580 and ISM-1585.
properties.query:
// Replace with your PIM-eligible Power Platform administrator UPNs or a Sentinel watchlist
let approved_admins = dynamic([
    "pp-admin1@yourdomain.gov.au",
    "pp-admin2@yourdomain.gov.au"
]);
PowerPlatformAdminActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventOriginalType == "GovernanceApiPolicyOperation"
| mv-expand PropertyCollection
| extend
    PropName = tostring(PropertyCollection.Name),
    PropValue = tostring(PropertyCollection.Value)
| summarize Props = make_bag(bag_pack(PropName, PropValue))
    by TimeGenerated, EventOriginalUid, ActorName
| extend
    Operation = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.tenant.governance.api_policy.operation_name"]),
    PolicyName = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.display_name"]),
    PolicyId = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.id"]),
    ActorUpn = coalesce(tostring(Props["enduser.principal_name"]), ActorName),
    SrcIpAddr = tostring(Props["enduser.ip_address"])
| where Operation in ("CreateDlpPolicy", "UpdateDlpPolicy", "DeleteDlpPolicy")
| where ActorUpn !in~ (approved_admins)
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(ActorUpn, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(ActorUpn, "@")[1]),
    CalculatedSeverity = iif(Operation == "DeleteDlpPolicy", "High", "Medium"),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0263, ISM-0580, ISM-1585"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ActorUpn,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    SrcIpAddr,
    Operation,
    PolicyName,
    PolicyId,
    CalculatedSeverity,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Power Platform - Environment created or moved outside approved regions
properties.description:
Detects Power Platform environment provisioning, copy or move operations targeting a geography outside the organisation's approved data residency list (default: Australia).
No out-of-the-box Business Applications rule monitors environment geography or lifecycle operations.
Note: Validate exact raw EventOriginalType lifecycle strings in your tenant via a 30-day summary query before tuning.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-1585 and ISM-0407.
properties.query:
// Adjust approved_regions to match organisational data sovereignty requirements
let approved_regions = dynamic(["australia", "australiaeast", "australiasoutheast"]);
let excluded_ops = dynamic([
    "EnvironmentPropertyChange",
    "EnvironmentAddedToEnvironmentGroup",
    "EnvironmentRemovedFromEnvironmentGroup"
]);
PowerPlatformAdminActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventOriginalType has "Environment"
| where EventOriginalType !in (excluded_ops)
| mv-expand PropertyCollection
| extend
    PropName = tostring(PropertyCollection.Name),
    PropValue = tostring(PropertyCollection.Value)
| summarize Props = make_bag(bag_pack(PropName, PropValue))
    by TimeGenerated, EventOriginalUid, EventOriginalType, ActorName
| extend
    EnvironmentId = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.id"]),
    EnvironmentUrl = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.url"]),
    Location = tolower(coalesce(
        tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.location"]),
        tostring(Props["location"]),
        "unknown"
    )),
    SrcIpAddr = tostring(Props["enduser.ip_address"]),
    AccountName = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-1585, ISM-0407"
| where Location !in (approved_regions)
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ActorName,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    SrcIpAddr,
    EventOriginalType,
    EnvironmentId,
    EnvironmentUrl,
    Location,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Power Platform - Admin self-elevation or Dataverse System Administrator granted
properties.description:
Detects a tenant administrator applying the System Administrator role to themselves inside an environment (ApplyAdminRole) or a Dataverse System Administrator role being associated with a user.
Complements the out-of-the-box rule 'Power Platform - Account added to privileged Microsoft Entra roles', which covers Entra directory roles only.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0445, ISM-1175 and ISM-1228.
properties.query:
// Populate with per-environment System Administrator role GUIDs from a Sentinel watchlist
let sysadmin_role_ids = dynamic([
    "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000101"
]);
union isfuzzy=true
(
    PowerPlatformAdminActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | where EventOriginalType == "ApplyAdminRole"
    | extend Properties = tostring(PropertyCollection)
    | extend
        Environment = extract(@'"powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.id","Value":"([^"]+)"', 1, Properties),
        SrcIpAddr = extract(@'"enduser.ip_address","Value":"([^"]+)"', 1, Properties)
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Actor = ActorName,
        SrcIpAddr,
        Action = "Tenant admin self-elevated via ApplyAdminRole",
        Environment,
        Target = ActorName
),
(
    DataverseActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | where Message == "Associate" and EntityName == "systemuser"
    | mv-expand Field = Fields
    | where tostring(Field.Name) == "role" and tostring(Field.Value) in~ (sysadmin_role_ids)
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Actor = UserId,
        SrcIpAddr = ClientIp,
        Action = "Dataverse System Administrator role assigned",
        Environment = InstanceUrl,
        Target = tostring(EntityId)
)
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(Actor, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(Actor, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0445, ISM-1175, ISM-1228"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Actor,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    SrcIpAddr,
    Action,
    Environment,
    Target,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Power Platform - High-risk connector added to a sensitive environment
properties.description:
Detects creation of a high-risk external, file-transfer, consumer or raw HTTP connection (PutConnection) inside a designated sensitive Power Platform environment.
Enhances the Low-severity out-of-the-box rule 'Power Platform - Connector added to a sensitive environment' by explicitly flagging high-risk exfiltration connectors at High severity.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0263 and ISM-1585.
properties.query:
// Replace with your sensitive production environment GUIDs (or read from a Sentinel watchlist)
let sensitive_environments = dynamic([
    "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000201"
]);
let high_risk_connectors = dynamic([
    "shared_http",
    "shared_webcontents",
    "shared_ftp",
    "shared_sftpwithssh",
    "shared_gmail",
    "shared_outlook",
    "shared_dropbox",
    "shared_googledrive",
    "shared_box",
    "shared_slack"
]);
PowerPlatformAdminActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventOriginalType == "PutConnection"
| mv-expand PropertyCollection
| extend
    PropName = tostring(PropertyCollection.Name),
    PropValue = tostring(PropertyCollection.Value)
| summarize Props = make_bag(bag_pack(PropName, PropValue))
    by TimeGenerated, EventOriginalUid, ActorName
| extend
    EnvironmentId = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.id"]),
    ConnectorId = tolower(tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.connector.id"])),
    ConnectionId = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.connection.id"]),
    SrcIpAddr = tostring(Props["enduser.ip_address"])
| where EnvironmentId in~ (sensitive_environments)
| where ConnectorId has_any (high_risk_connectors)
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0263, ISM-1585"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ActorName,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    SrcIpAddr,
    EnvironmentId,
    ConnectorId,
    ConnectionId,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Power Platform - Tenant isolation disabled or environment security group modified
properties.description:
Alerts immediately when Power Platform tenant isolation is turned off or an environment's Microsoft Entra security group binding is changed.
Closes a gap in the out-of-the-box rule 'Dataverse - Guest user exfiltration following Power Platform defense impairment', which only triggers after exfiltration alerts follow.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0263, ISM-0407 and ISM-1585.
properties.query:
PowerPlatformAdminActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where (EventOriginalType == "TenantIsolationOperation"
         and PropertyCollection has "powerplatform.analytics.resource.tenant.isolation_policy.enabled")
     or (EventOriginalType == "EnvironmentPropertyChange"
         and PropertyCollection has "SecurityGroupId")
| mv-expand PropertyCollection
| extend
    PropName = tostring(PropertyCollection.Name),
    PropValue = tostring(PropertyCollection.Value)
| summarize Props = make_bag(bag_pack(PropName, PropValue))
    by TimeGenerated, EventOriginalUid, EventOriginalType, ActorName
| extend
    IsolationEnabled = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.tenant.isolation_policy.enabled"]),
    EnvironmentId = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.id"]),
    EnvironmentUrl = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.url"]),
    SrcIpAddr = tostring(Props["enduser.ip_address"]),
    AccountName = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0263, ISM-0407, ISM-1585"
| where EventOriginalType == "EnvironmentPropertyChange" or IsolationEnabled =~ "False"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ActorName,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    SrcIpAddr,
    EventOriginalType,
    IsolationEnabled,
    EnvironmentId,
    EnvironmentUrl,
    ISMControls
